text: RSK Group Limited's only active person with significant control is Alan Ryder Investments Limited, with more than 25% but not more than 50% of its shares and voting rights; Alan Ryder Investments Limited's only active person with significant control is RSK founder and chief executive Dr Alasdair Alan Ryder, with 75% or more of its shares and voting rights.

source.name: Companies House: RSK GROUP LIMITED persons with significant control
source.quote: Nature of control Ownership of shares – More than 25% but not more than 50%
source.note: The page lists Alan Ryder Investments Limited as RSK Group Limited's only active person with significant control, with this nature of control over both shares and voting rights.

additionalSources.name: Companies House: ALAN RYDER INVESTMENTS LIMITED persons with significant control
additionalSources.quote: Nature of control Ownership of shares – 75% or more
additionalSources.note: The page lists Dr Alasdair Alan Ryder as Alan Ryder Investments Limited's only active person with significant control, with 75% or more of shares and voting rights. RSK's own site identifies Alan Ryder as 'RSK founder, Chief Executive Officer' (rskgroup.com/news/rsk-group-and-charlton-athletic-renew-partnership/).
